messages.subject: tsDyn: new update 0.7-4
messages.body_plain:
Hi

The tsDyn package has ben recently updated to its version 0.7-3 and then
0.7-4.

The important changes include finally the Hansen Seo (2002) test for
linear versus threshold cointegration, the Johansen estimator for the
linear VECM, and especially the parallelization of all the heavy
burdensome bootstrap tests (Hansen (1999), Hansen and Seo (2002), Seo
(2006)....) thanks to pacjage foreach. Results are good and show that
using 2 cores can reduce by 2 the computing time, 4 cores by 3!

A presentation showing the main features of the packages (made for price
transmission workshop in Gottingen) is available upon request.

Detailed changes include:

Version 0.7-40
-Add paralell option for TVAR.LRtest(), setarTest(), TVECM.Seotest()
-regime() works also for nlVar, also add arguments initVal and timeAttr
-RENAME function TVECM.HSTest in TVECM.HStest
-correct bug in TVECM.HSTest

Version 0.7-30
-Add function TVECM.HStest (before was HanSeo_TVECM). Has new argument
hpc for parallel computing.
-Add function VECM(), simple wrapper for lineVar(..., model="VECM")
-Add Johansen estimator for VECM()
-Add methods AIC, BIC, logLik for class VECM
-Correct numerous bugs
